tasks.title: Never leave revealed content hidden at 400% zoom or small viewports

Any hidden element whose top is at or above the viewport bottom is revealed (elements jumped over by fast scroll, End or a hash link included), and a fallback reveals every remaining hidden element if the observer has not fired for it within 1s after it enters or passes the viewport
Revealing does not depend on the element fitting the viewport: threshold and rootMargin work for elements taller than a 256px viewport, and no element is hidden before JavaScript runs
Without IntersectionObserver and under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce nothing is hidden, and yarn typecheck, yarn lint and yarn build pass

tasks.title: Add Vitest and the pure journey state and XP function with edge-case tests
acceptance: vitest is a devDependency (version compatible with Vite 6) and package.json has "test": "vitest run"; the only test file is src/lib/journey-state.test.ts and there is no coverage config

tasks.title: Add the lazy-loaded 3D scene shell with starfield, capability gate and ADR
acceptance: three is a dependency imported only through dynamic import() from the journey page: the build emits a separate chunk and the home main chunk grows at most 2 kB gzip (before and after sizes recorded in the task summary)

The 3D scene loads only with WebGL2, without prefers-reduced-motion, without Save-Data and with navigator.deviceMemory >= 4 when defined; otherwise, and when the chunk fails to load, the T-060 HTML map stays as the view with no visible error

The canvas is aria-hidden behind the HUD and renders a starfield/nebula with depth; DPR is capped at 2, the render loop stops while the tab is hidden, and renderer, geometries, materials and textures are disposed on unmount and pagehide
A new ADR in docs/adr/ (next free number, with "Quando reabrir") records the three.js dependency, its budget and the fallback rules
yarn typecheck, yarn lint and yarn build pass
notes: 2026-11-25 rodada 9 (PO): Spec docs/specs/2026-11-25-jornada-ai-engineer.md step (d), Goals 4, 7 and 8. New dependency (three) required by the spec.

tasks.title: Render the worlds as planets with completed, current and locked visuals and the light trail
acceptance: The scene draws one planet per world and the final boss as a star or black hole at the end, linked by a light trail, with count and order taken from the journey content (no hardcoded 8)
completed: lit planet with ring and achievement seal; current: pulsing glow, orbiting particles and trail lit up to it; locked: dark, desaturated, lock marker and trail off
Statuses come only from the T-058 function (no status literal assigned per world in scene code), and the HTML list of T-060 stays in the DOM and reachable by screen readers while the 3D view is on
yarn typecheck, yarn lint and yarn build pass
notes: 2026-11-25 rodada 9 (PO): Spec docs/specs/2026-11-25-jornada-ai-engineer.md step (d), Goal 4.

tasks.title: Add camera parallax and keyboard, scroll and focus navigation between worlds
acceptance: Mouse movement moves the camera with a soft parallax; on mobile, device orientation does the same only where it needs no permission prompt

Arrow keys and wheel/scroll move the camera to the previous or next world; focusing a world control in the HTML moves the camera to that planet, and Tab order follows the world order with visible focus
Opening the journey page with #world-3 (en) or #mundo-3 (pt-BR) starts with the camera on world 3
yarn typecheck, yarn lint and yarn build pass
notes: 2026-11-25 rodada 9 (PO): Spec docs/specs/2026-11-25-jornada-ai-engineer.md Goals 4 and 7, edge case "Link com hash vindo de fora".

tasks.title: Add the world panel dialog opened from planets
acceptance: Clicking a planet, or pressing Enter on its focused world control in the 3D view, opens a dialog with the world name, XP bar, checklist (done / not done), boss and deliverable link when present
Focus is trapped in the dialog, Esc and the close button close it, and focus returns to the control that opened it
A locked world's dialog shows "Locked: defeat the boss of World N-1" / "Bloqueado: derrote o chefão do Mundo N-1" and its item list
At 320px and at 400% zoom the dialog scrolls and the close button stays reachable; axe-core reports no violations with the dialog open, and yarn typecheck, yarn lint and yarn build pass
tasks.notes: 2026-11-25 rodada 9 (PO): Spec docs/specs/2026-11-25-jornada-ai-engineer.md Goals 5 and 7.,2026-11-26: 2 achado(s) blocker após 2 ciclos de correção Concluída pela sessão principal em 2026-11-26 a partir do stash esteira/2026-11-26/review/T-066, com o fix do allowlist data-scene-pick pedido pelo code-reviewer e pelo ui-reviewer.

tasks.title: Add the change-of-dimension light tunnel transition into the journey
acceptance: Clicking the Journey link in the nav, the home teaser or the 404 page plays a light tunnel/warp of 1.2 to 1.8s and navigates in the same tab; the journey opens with an entrance already in space, using cross-document View Transitions where supported
Direct access by URL or by an external hash link shows only the entrance, with no tunnel; ctrl/cmd/shift/middle clicks behave as normal links
With prefers-reduced-motion the navigation is immediate with no tunnel or entrance animation
Going back from the journey with the browser button shows the previous page with no blank screen or stuck overlay (pageshow/bfcache handled)
The home main chunk stays within the 2 kB gzip budget of T-063 counting this change, and yarn typecheck, yarn lint and yarn build pass
notes: 2026-11-25 rodada 9 (PO): Spec docs/specs/2026-11-25-jornada-ai-engineer.md step (e), Goal 3 and edge case "Botão voltar".

tasks.title: Polish the journey effects: bloom, hover feedback and XP fill on entry
acceptance: A bloom/glow post-processing pass applies to lit planets, the current planet and the lit trail, using only modules shipped with three (no new dependency)
Hovering or focusing a planet highlights it (scale or glow) and the cursor becomes a pointer; locked planets get a distinct, dimmer highlight
On first entry the HUD XP bars fill from 0 to their value; under prefers-reduced-motion they render at the final value
HUD text keeps >= 4.5:1 contrast over the brightest part of the scene behind it, axe-core reports no violations in 3D and reduced-motion modes, and yarn typecheck, yarn lint and yarn build pass

vite.config.ts sets build.chunkSizeWarningLimit to the smallest round value above the scene chunk (in kB, no more than 50 kB of headroom), yarn build prints no chunk size warning, and ADR 0009 gets a dated addendum explaining that the chunk loads only on the journey page
notes: 2026-11-25 rodada 9 (PO): Spec docs/specs/2026-11-25-jornada-ai-engineer.md step (f), stakeholder "intensidade máxima" on this page.

tasks.title: Fix keyboard navigation gaps in the journey world list
acceptance: With focus on the World 0 card, ArrowDown moves focus to World 1 and each further ArrowDown moves exactly one card until the final boss; ArrowUp walks back the same way, with no card skipped (useActiveStage in src/lib/use-active-stage.ts)
Focusing a card (Tab or click) locks the active index the same way a hash or arrow scroll does, so the scroll that follows focus cannot switch the camera to another card
The keyboard hint is referenced by aria-describedby on every focusable card (not only on the <ol>), so a screen reader announces it when a card receives focus
yarn typecheck, yarn lint, yarn test and yarn build pass, and axe-core reports no violations on /en/journey/ and /pt/jornada/
notes: 2026-11-26 rodada 10 (PO): opened from the T-065 reviewer minors in docs/pipeline/runs/2026-11-25-3.md: (a) onFocusIn without lock(), (b) aria-describedby on the <ol>, (f) first ArrowDown skips World 0. REPORT T-065 item says the PO may open a task. A visible hint and role on the <li> stay as review questions.

tasks.title: Add a visible pause control for the journey scene animation
acceptance: In 3D mode /en/journey/ and /pt/jornada/ show a button "Pause animation" / "Pausar animação" with aria-pressed, placed before the world list in the tab order and visible without scrolling at 375px and 1280px
Pressing it stops the render loop, the current-world pulse, orbiting particles and parallax (no frame is drawn while paused); pressing again resumes from the same state
The button is not rendered in the 2D fallback or under prefers-reduced-motion, where nothing moves
The button has visible focus, hover, :active and disabled states from the design tokens, a 44x44px target, and >= 4.5:1 text contrast over the scene; yarn typecheck, yarn lint and yarn build pass
notes: 2026-11-26 rodada 10 (PO): decision: WCAG 2.2.2 (Pause, Stop, Hide, level A, part of the 2.1 AA target in CLAUDE.md) requires a pause for decorative motion that starts on load and lasts over 5s. Today only prefers-reduced-motion stops it (REPORT T-063 item). Depends on T-068 so the pause also covers bloom and hover effects.

tasks.title: Let the 3D scene show through the journey content while keeping AA contrast
acceptance: At 1280x800 and 375x812 in 3D mode, the current planet is visible on first load, not covered by an opaque card or by the scrim

The scrim and card backgrounds are set so every text on the journey page measures >= 4.5:1 (>= 3:1 for large text) against the brightest scene pixel behind it, with the measured worst case written in ADR 0007 as a dated addendum
The 2D fallback and reduced-motion mode keep the current opaque cards and their contrast unchanged
axe-core reports no violations on /en/journey/ and /pt/jornada/ in 3D and reduced-motion modes, and yarn typecheck, yarn lint and yarn build pass
notes: 2026-11-26 rodada 10 (PO): decision: the spec asks for maximum intensity on this page and a visible 3D map, but REPORT T-063/T-064 says the 70% scrim and opaque cards hide almost all of it. The PO picks the direction (scene visible, AA kept); the exact values (scrim around 55%, translucent or narrower cards) are left to the dev as long as the measured contrast passes. Depends on T-068 because bloom changes the brightest pixel.

yarn build shows main-*.js + warp-*.js at or below 93.58 kB gzip in total (measured 95.64 kB on 2026-11-26), and ADR 0009 gets a dated addendum with the before/after table
dist/en/index.html and dist/pt/index.html do not reference or modulepreload the journey or books chunks

/en/journey/, /pt/jornada/, /en/books/ and /pt/livros/ render with no layout shift from the Suspense fallback (fallback reserves the main area with min-h-[100dvh]), the URL hash focus of T-040 still works on them, and the light tunnel of T-067 still plays
yarn typecheck, yarn lint, yarn test and yarn build pass
